launch_distributed: launch distributed training across GPUs on the current node with a VISSL config and engine name
launch_distributed_on_slurm: launch distributed training on a SLURM cluster allocating nodes and GPUs from the config
create_submitit_executor: create a SLURM submitit executor configured from the VISSL config for scheduling jobs on a cluster
run_engine: run the train or extract_features engine with distributed config, checkpoint path, and hook generator
copy_data_to_local: copy dataset splits to local disk for faster dataloading during distributed training
